name: Azure API Management
sku: Azure API Management across its Classic, V2 and Consumption tiers. Which features belong to which tier was not checked, so no score carries an enterprise-tier constraint. Azure API Center, which inventories APIs, is a separate service and is not scored.

bands.note: The gateway verifies API keys, JWTs and certificates on every request, and Microsoft Entra ID can authenticate developers and authorise calls. Products group APIs and can require a subscription key that an administrator approves.
Policies change an API's behaviour through configuration: usage quotas and rate limits, format conversion such as XML to JSON, and response caching, applied globally or per product, API or operation.
The gateway emits logs, metrics and traces, with Azure Monitor for reporting and alerting and Application Insights for live metrics and end-to-end tracing.

proposed_capabilities.name: API gateway for data access
proposed_capabilities.description: Publishing a data source or a model as a managed, secured and metered API, with keys, quotas and a developer portal, so applications and partners consume data without direct database access. The gateway fronts the data; it does not store, query or transform it.

presentation.tagline: API gateway that publishes, secures and meters access to data and services.
